description: [Volatility-Regime / Band-Squeeze Factor] Ratio of the current 20-session population standard deviation to its own trailing 40-session rolling mean. Values below 1 indicate the bands are currently tighter than their recent norms (squeeze regime); the ratio is scalar and interpretable. The lookback is corrected from the rejected version: the outer trailing mean window is reduced from 60 to 40 sessions so the total consumed history is 20 + 40 - 1 = 59 sessions, satisfying the 60-session cap with ALL rolling min_periods equal to their full window. No additional parameters beyond the fixed 20/2 band are introduced.
limitations: Implementation availability and historical checks do not establish profitable or stable out-of-sample returns.
Rolling windows require all observations (min_periods equals window); missing inputs and warmup rows remain missing.

Original 20/60 proposal consumed79 prices and was rejected under the historical60-observation cap; accepted20/40 formula consumes59. The earlier pctB20/deltaB20_5/squeeze20_60 proposal rejection remains in provenance/proposal-rejections.json.

adapter_validation.scope: Implementation parity only; no performance test, selection or profitability conclusion.
adapter_validation.causality_and_worker_checks: Run factor validate to record current-runtime contract checks separately.
